conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: A blinded creature can't see and automatically fails any ability check that requires sight.
effects: Can't see
Automatically fails ability checks requiring sight
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage
The creature's attack rolls have Disadvantage

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: A charmed creature is beguiled by the charmer.
effects: Can't take any action that harms the charmer
The charmer has Advantage on any ability check to interact socially with the creature

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: A deafened creature can't hear and automatically fails any ability check that requires hearing.
effects: Can't hear
Automatically fails ability checks requiring hearing

conditions.name: Exhaustion
conditions.description: Exhaustion is measured in six levels. Each level of exhaustion imposes penalties.
effects: Level 1: Disadvantage on ability checks
Level 2: Speed halved
Level 3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws
Level 4: Hit Point maximum halved
Level 5: Speed reduced to 0
Level 6: Death
conditions.notes: Finishing a Long Rest removes 1 level of Exhaustion if the creature has ingested food and drink. Being raised from the dead also removes 1 level.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: A frightened creature is terrified of the source of its fear.
effects: Has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of fear is in line of sight
Can't willingly move closer to the source of fear

conditions.name: Grappled
conditions.description: A grappled creature is held by another creature or effect.
effects: Speed becomes 0
Can't benefit from any bonus to Speed
The condition ends if the grappler is Incapacitated
The condition ends if the grappled creature is moved outside the grappler's reach

conditions.name: Incapacitated
conditions.description: An incapacitated creature can't take actions or reactions.
effects: Can't take actions
Can't take Bonus Actions
Can't take Reactions

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: An invisible creature is impossible to see without the aid of magic or a special sense.
effects: Impossible to see without magic or special senses
Considered Heavily Obscured for the purpose of hiding
Can be detected by noise or tracks
Attack rolls against the creature have Disadvantage
The creature's attack rolls have Advantage

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: A paralyzed creature is frozen in place.
effects: Has the Incapacitated condition
Can't move or speak
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage
Any attack that hits is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: A petrified creature is transformed into a solid inanimate substance.
effects: Transformed into stone along with nonmagical objects worn or carried
Weight increases by a factor of ten
Ceases aging
Has the Incapacitated condition
Can't move or speak
Unaware of surroundings
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Has Resistance to all damage
Has Immunity to Poison and Disease

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: A poisoned creature suffers from a toxin.
effects: Disadvantage on attack rolls
Disadvantage on ability checks

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: A prone creature is lying on the ground.
effects: The only movement option is to crawl (every foot of crawling costs 1 extra foot of movement)
Has Disadvantage on attack rolls
Attack rolls from within 5 feet have Advantage against the creature
Attack rolls from more than 5 feet away have Disadvantage against the creature
Can stand up by spending movement equal to half Speed

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: A restrained creature is held in place by bindings, webbing, or other effects.
effects: Speed becomes 0
Can't benefit from any bonus to Speed
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage
The creature's attack rolls have Disadvantage
Has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: A stunned creature is dazed and unable to act effectively.
effects: Has the Incapacitated condition
Can't move
Can speak only falteringly
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: An unconscious creature is completely unaware and unable to act.
effects: Has the Incapacitated condition
Can't move or speak
Unaware of surroundings
Drops whatever it's holding and falls Prone
Automatically fails Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Attack rolls against the creature have Advantage
Any attack that hits is a Critical Hit if the attacker is within 5 feet
